plan_scope: Wave D2 — State technical universities (Engineering; AICTE / UGC), approximately 30 expected. The plan's engineering tier examples include RTU, RGPV, AKTU, DTU, Jadavpur University, and CUSAT.
scope_note: This is a research shortlist, not an eligibility decision or import file. Core candidates are state technical universities or public technical universities with engineering/technology as their core mandate. Boundary candidates are state public universities with substantive engineering programmes but a broader mandate; keep them out of D2 unless the project confirms that wider rule. Colleges, individual campuses/departments, and state technical education boards are not listed as university candidates.

database_comparison.match_basis: Compared canonical university names and common acronyms against institute names and inspected matching institute_classification and institute_domain_tiers rows. No aliases or records were written.
